findings: PS5 payload SDK provides __dlopen hooks, but the Java port maps them to a generated table of statically linked core libraries. Arbitrary ELF/JNI loading is unsupported, so libjvm.so cannot be dlopen'd at runtime.
The Java 25 runtime ships as eboot-linked HotSpot objects plus assets/java25/lib/modules and conf. Reusing it requires the macOS OpenJDK cross-build from ps5-java25-homebrew.
ProsperoCraft verified Paper and Fabric 26.3 on console with a fixed probe pipeline; it is a launcher, not a multi-instance manager.
websrv is libmicrohttpd-based with MHD keep-alive, no WebSocket route; the dashboard must poll.
PS5_VulkanTemplate needs a pinned PS5_PayloadSDK fork (ps5platform) and a PS5_Vulkan RADV archive; neither is present in this environment.
